433static void qrf(real_T A[90], int32_T ia0, int32_T m, int32_T n, int32_T nfxd,

460/* Function for MATLAB Function: '<S1>/qp_solver' */



461static void qrpf(real_T A[90], int32_T ia0, int32_T m, int32_T n, int32_T nfxd,



462                 real_T tau[9], int32_T jpvt[10], DW *rtDW)



463{

476

479  memset(&rtDW->vn2[0], 0, 10U * sizeof(real_T));

487    ii_tmp = i * 9 + ia0;

497        rtDW->smax = fabs(rtDW->vn1[i]);



498        for (iy = 2; iy <= nmi; iy++) {



499          ix++;



500          rtDW->temp2 = fabs(rtDW->vn1[ix]);



501          if (rtDW->temp2 > rtDW->smax) {



502            pvt = iy - 1;



503            rtDW->smax = rtDW->temp2;



504          }



505        }



506      }



507    }



508



509    pvt += i;



510    if (pvt + 1 != i + 1) {



511      ix = (pvt * 9 + ia0) - 1;



512      iy = ii_tmp - 1;



513      for (ii_tmp = 0; ii_tmp < m; ii_tmp++) {



514        rtDW->smax = A[ix];



515        A[ix] = A[iy];



516        A[iy] = rtDW->smax;



517        ix++;



518        iy++;



519      }



520



521      ix = jpvt[pvt];



522      jpvt[pvt] = jpvt[i];



523      jpvt[i] = ix;



524      rtDW->vn1[pvt] = rtDW->vn1[i];



525      rtDW->vn2[pvt] = rtDW->vn2[i];



526    }



527



528    if (i + 1 < m) {



529      rtDW->smax = A[rtDW->ii];



530      tau[i] = xzlarfg(mmi, &rtDW->smax, A, rtDW->ii + 2, rtDW);



531      A[rtDW->ii] = rtDW->smax;



532    } else {



533      tau[i] = 0.0;



534    }



535



536    if (i + 1 < n) {



537      rtDW->smax = A[rtDW->ii];



538      A[rtDW->ii] = 1.0;



539      xzlarf(mmi, nmi - 1, rtDW->ii + 1, tau[i], A, rtDW->ii + 10, rtDW->work_c,



540             rtDW);



541      A[rtDW->ii] = rtDW->smax;



542    }



543



544    rtDW->ii = i + 1;



545    while (rtDW->ii + 1 <= n) {



546      nmi = (ia0 + i) + rtDW->ii * 9;



547      if (rtDW->vn1[rtDW->ii] != 0.0) {



548        rtDW->smax = fabs(A[nmi - 1]) / rtDW->vn1[rtDW->ii];



549        rtDW->smax = 1.0 - rtDW->smax * rtDW->smax;



550        if (rtDW->smax < 0.0) {



551          rtDW->smax = 0.0;



552        }



553



554        rtDW->temp2 = rtDW->vn1[rtDW->ii] / rtDW->vn2[rtDW->ii];



555        rtDW->temp2 = rtDW->temp2 * rtDW->temp2 * rtDW->smax;



556        if (rtDW->temp2 <= 1.4901161193847656E-8) {

559            rtDW->vn2[rtDW->ii] = rtDW->vn1[rtDW->ii];



560          } else {



561            rtDW->vn1[rtDW->ii] = 0.0;



562            rtDW->vn2[rtDW->ii] = 0.0;



563          }



564        } else {

567      }

570    }



571  }

574/* Function for MATLAB Function: '<S1>/qp_solver' */



575static void xzgeqp3(real_T A[90], int32_T ia0, int32_T m, int32_T n, int32_T



576                    jpvt[10], real_T tau[9], DW *rtDW)



577{



578  if (m < n) {

580  } else {



581    rtDW->minmn = n;



582  }



583



584  memset(&tau[0], 0, 9U * sizeof(real_T));



585  if (rtDW->minmn < 1) {



586    rtDW->minmn = 0;



587    while (rtDW->minmn <= n - 1) {



588      jpvt[rtDW->minmn] = rtDW->minmn + 1;



589      rtDW->minmn++;



590    }



591  } else {



592    rtDW->i_h = -1;



593    rtDW->c_j_c = 0;



594    while (rtDW->c_j_c <= n - 1) {



595      if (jpvt[rtDW->c_j_c] != 0) {



596        rtDW->i_h++;



597        if (rtDW->c_j_c + 1 != rtDW->i_h + 1) {



598          rtDW->ix_m = (rtDW->c_j_c * 9 + ia0) - 1;



599          rtDW->iy_m = (rtDW->i_h * 9 + ia0) - 1;



600          rtDW->k_j = 0;



601          while (rtDW->k_j <= m - 1) {



602            rtDW->temp_c = A[rtDW->ix_m];



603            A[rtDW->ix_m] = A[rtDW->iy_m];



604            A[rtDW->iy_m] = rtDW->temp_c;



605            rtDW->ix_m++;



606            rtDW->iy_m++;



607            rtDW->k_j++;



608          }



609



610          jpvt[rtDW->c_j_c] = jpvt[rtDW->i_h];



611          jpvt[rtDW->i_h] = rtDW->c_j_c + 1;



612        } else {



613          jpvt[rtDW->c_j_c] = rtDW->c_j_c + 1;



614        }



615      } else {



616        jpvt[rtDW->c_j_c] = rtDW->c_j_c + 1;



617      }



618



619      rtDW->c_j_c++;



620    }



621



622    if (rtDW->i_h + 1 < rtDW->minmn) {



623      rtDW->i_h++;



624    } else {



625      rtDW->i_h = rtDW->minmn;



626    }



627



628    qrf(A, ia0, m, n, rtDW->i_h, tau, rtDW);



629    if (rtDW->i_h < rtDW->minmn) {



630      qrpf(A, ia0, m, n, rtDW->i_h, tau, jpvt, rtDW);



631    }



632  }

2602static void xrotg(real_T *a, real_T *b, real_T *c, real_T *s, DW *rtDW)



2603{

2618    *b = 0.0;



2619  } else {



2620    ads = rtDW->absa / scale;



2621    bds = rtDW->absb / scale;



2622    scale *= sqrt(ads * ads + bds * bds);

2635    }



2636  }

2639}
